parsed.faithful: The translation of the way, according to the Arabian historian, was miraculous, the vast number of birds named _Aobhli_ came from the sea, having faces like lions; each carrying in its claw a small stone about the size of a pea, which they let fall upon the Ethiopian army in such numbers, that every one of them was destroyed. At this time it is said that the small-pox first made its appearance; and the more probable account of the destruction of the Ethiopian army is, that they perished by this distemper.
